body: If anyone knows of a way around this problem temporarily, even if it requires editing the files in node_modules\\@angular-devkit\build-angular\src\webpack\configs\, I would be very grateful.

This seems to be a problem caused by the Angular compiler which strips comments in CSS, which in this case causes sourcemap lines not to match.

https://github.com/angular/angular/blob/85b4941be137a2fcdc664dc870e408dd72ad7de7/packages/compiler/src/shadow_css.ts#L142

That said, this problem only effects the webpack based builders as esbuild does not emit non important comments.
@incapdns, that looks like a separate, unrelated issue to the one originally opened, do you mind opening a new issue in the CLI repo? Thanks
